source_issue.title: Extension points: extra volumes, init containers, sidecars, envFrom, labels, topology spread, priority class

summary_markdown:
## What this issue is about
This issue discusses enhancing the functionality of Plone Helm Charts by allowing additional features such as extra volumes, init containers, sidecars, environment variables (`envFrom`), labels, topology spread constraints, priority classes, and service annotations. These enhancements aim to make the workloads more flexible and versatile.

## What needs to be done
The primary task is to implement support for the features mentioned above, using key names commonly found in other Helm charts. Additionally, this implementation is dependent on another issue (#36), which may need attention.

## Helpful background
Helm charts are templates used to deploy applications on Kubernetes. Understanding terms like "volumes" (storage elements), "init containers" (specific tasks before the main container starts), and "sidecars" (additional helper containers) will be beneficial. These features collectively enhance the deployment's capabilities.

## Good first steps
1. Familiarize yourself with the existing Helm chart structure and how workloads are currently defined.
2. Review issue #36 to understand any dependencies that may affect your implementation.
3. Consider starting with one feature at a time, like adding extra volumes or labels, to simplify the process.
4. Engage with the team or the original author, [ericof](https://github.com/ericof), for any clarifications.
